notes: Peiligang culture, a Neolithic culture of Henan; the page says it 'existed from about 7000 to 5000 BC' and the infobox gives '7000-5000 BC', so it began a millennium before the project's first year; the dossier starts at -6000 (the floor). Extent: the page gives only 'Henan', the 'Yi-Luo river basin', the type site in Xinzheng County and 'over 100 sites' in 'about 100 square kilometers'; the map cannot draw 100 km2, so two 60 km discs (Zhengzhou for Xinzheng, Luoyang for the Yi-Luo basin) are drawn, which overstates the site cluster and is a placement (confidence 2). Jiahu: the Jiahu page says its last two phases (6600-5700 BC) 'correspond to the Peiligang culture' and that it was 'flooded and abandoned around 5700 BC'; some archaeologists treat Jiahu as a separate neighbouring culture, so it is drawn at confidence 2 and removed in 5700. The Wuyang position is read from the page's '22 km north of modern Wuyang'; the gazetteer lacks Wuyang, so Luohe 50 km stands in. Predecessor: the infobox names the Nanzhuangtou culture (no dates on the page, before the floor, no dossier). Successor: the infobox names the Yangshao culture; the Yangshao page lists the Peiligang among its predecessors without a date, so the 5000 BCE hand-over is the Yangshao page's start year (confidence 2). The Cishan page calls the Peiligang 'its southern neighbor' and says the two 'were once grouped as the Cishan-Peiligang culture'; no dates for either relation. No area figure to compare with Cliopatria (Cliopatria holds nothing before 3400 BCE).
